description: This PHP source file defines the SaleTax controller class within the OpenCart admin extension, responsible for managing the sale tax report, including rendering views, handling configuration save, and generating report data.

classes.name: SaleTax
classes.description: Controller class for managing the sale tax report in the OpenCart admin panel, including rendering report pages and saving report configuration.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the sale tax report page, loads language, sets titles, breadcrumbs, and prepares data for view rendering.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving configuration settings for the sale tax report, with permission check and JSON response.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the sale tax report, loads order statuses, and prepares data for the report view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the list of sale tax data, primarily invoking getReport.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Fetches and formats the sale tax report data based on filters, handles pagination, and returns the rendered HTML view.
